scope: Visual assembly review of every page of the complete key volume; exact preservation of all retained source headers and bodies; native-resolution inspection of every new or intentionally blank page and every final footer.

reviewer_roles.explanation: The reviewer authored the raster verifier, then actually inspected the page proofs. This receipt does not claim independent authorship of that verification method or a new linguistic review of the accepted keys. The coordinator owns assembly and separate text/navigation/protected-input checks.

method.retained_header_body_comparison: Exact equality of decoded RGB channel bytes for rows 0–1327, inclusive, for each retained source page and its assembled counterpart; not merely equal text or PNG encodings.

footer_exclusion.guard_expectation: Every RGB channel is 255 in the full-width blank gap around the cutoff.

method.whole_page_inspection: All 486 pages observed as labelled reduced structural overviews in 31 contact sheets opened at original sheet resolution. Checked layout, sequence, component boundaries, tables, margins, clipping, collisions and anomalous blank content.
method.footer_inspection: All 486 footer strips observed at native pixel resolution in 21 labelled sheets. Compared every printed folio against its physical-page/PDF-label caption, including intentionally unprinted title and blank folios.
method.new_page_inspection: All four front-matter pages and seven inserted body blank pages opened individually at native full-page resolution. Checked title, explanatory page, complete contents, blank versos and special characters.
method.limitation: Reduced contact-sheet pages do not support a fresh word-by-word linguistic audit. Retained text, tables and special-character shapes are accepted here by exact body/header pixel preservation against the accepted standalone PDFs; new pages and changed footers were inspected at native size.
